where: super-terminators · Chaos Terminators · Bloody Fury
why: Your Shooting is right. Their Movement for Fire Overwatch follows the signed-off Furious Onslaught convention. For the owner: snap shooting (15.09) says "You cannot re-roll hit rolls". Your Charge only is too narrow. "When this unit declares a charge" has no turn limit, and Heroic Intervention ("End of your opponent’s Charge phase … Resolve a charge with your unit (11.02)") runs 11.02, whose first step is "That unit declares a charge". The Chaos Terminators are an unengaged INFANTRY unit the app offers it to. This matches the signed-off Harpooned tag (charge, either), and the FAQ about steps 2–3 covers charges "outside of the charge phase", not this one. Should be ph:['movement','shooting','charge'], turn:'your', turns:{ movement:'opp', charge:'either' }. The text has every word of the pack’s Rules Update. Only its bullet nesting is flattened: part 1 and the "When this unit declares a charge … If you do:" lead-in are paragraphs, and the two sub-bullets follow as bullets.
